description: An AI agent that performs a security audit on a target codebase.

summary.one_liner: A Nerve agent that performs a security audit on a target codebase and writes its findings to AUDIT.md.
summary.what_it_does: The agent points at a target directory (the current folder by default, or a path given with --target-path) and performs a security audit of the code. Its findings are appended to an AUDIT.md file in the current working directory as markdown, for review and documentation. It is installed and run through the Nerve agent framework. The README does not describe the specific vulnerability classes checked, the models used, or the audit methodology in detail.
use_cases: Auditing a local codebase for security issues
Generating a markdown security audit report
Reviewing an unfamiliar project for vulnerabilities
Documenting security findings for a code review
notable: Runs as a Nerve agent installed with a single nerve install command
Writes findings to AUDIT.md in markdown for easy review
Accepts any target path via --target-path, defaulting to the current folder
caveats: Requires the Nerve framework, version 1.4.x or later
README does not state which languages, vulnerability classes, or models are supported
License is not clearly stated; GitHub reports NOASSERTION
